en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The most hateful of the people to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is a man who bares the back of a Muslim without a right (to do so)’.
